_doc: Which ambience bed each Hollow Crown region plays (scripts/match/amb_beds.gd, docs/AUDIO.md 'Region ambience'). beds: region id (content/maps/hollowcrown.json regions[].id, made by tools/make_hollowcrown.py) -> the loop audio/amb_<bed>.ogg, all from the existing library. fade_s: how long a bed takes to go from silent to full, so crossing a border is a crossfade of that length (3-4 s). blight_k: the bed's level (x) at 40 m or more past the tide ring, inside the Blight, where amb_blight's rumble takes over; it falls from 1 at the ring.
